summary: Frontend-only verification round (no backend) for 4 reported bug fixes + POS/Dashboard regressions on https://vilmaai-pos-v1.preview.emergentagent.com. Ran 4 Playwright suites (desktop 1920x1080, 1440x760, mobile 390x844). BUG1 (native scroll after disabling Lenis) verified on dashboard main, POS product grid, POS cart scroll area (independent, footer pinned) and sidebar nav (overflowing at 760px height, scrollTop moved). BUG2 sidebar groups verified: brand 'Diedo App'/'Admin Console', nav-group-pos/crm/finanzas expand with all expected sub-items, sub-item 'Punto de Venta' navigates to /pos, nav-dashboard navigates to /dashboard, group auto-expands for current route, chevron rotates, sidebar-logout shows toast. BUG3 verified: fixed footer (182px) contains ONLY Subtotal/ITBIS(18%)/Total/Cobrar (no discount, payment section or secondary actions inside it) and stays pinned (btn bottom unchanged after scrolling cart). BUG4 verified: pos-payment-reference accepts input, placeholder changes per method (Efectivo/Tarjeta/Transferencia), pos-transfer-upload appears for transferencia, checkout blocked with pos-transfer-error when no proof. Regressions all pass: add product updates items/subtotal/total in RD$, qty inc/dec/remove, 10% discount math correct (21,600 - 2,160 => ITBIS 3,499.20 => total 22,939.20), category bubbles filter (Depto laser => 5 of 18), search (axilas => 1, zzzz => 'Sin resultados'), customer selector (6 options, selection reflected), branch selector (3 options, switched to Charm Santiago), checkout success toast + cart cleared + paymentReference cleared from persisted store, Gasto modal validation ('Ingresa un concepto para el gasto.') then submit closes, empty cart shows 'Carrito vacío' with Cobrar disabled. Dashboard period filter updates KPIs (48,200 -> 642,300) and Recharts line chart renders. Zero JS console errors across all runs.

issues: Sonner toasts (bottom-right) overlap the pinned cart footer, temporarily covering the Total and the 'Cobrar' button; consider bottom-center/top-right or offsetting the toaster on the POS screen.
All product cards render icon placeholders (no images) - cosmetic only, appears intentional for mock data.

action_items: Optional: move/offset the toast position so it does not cover the pinned Total/Cobrar footer in the POS cart.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar GroupItem sub-items use data-testid=`nav-sub-<path>` (e.g. nav-sub-/pos) which embeds slashes; prefer a slug id for stable selectors.
Branch dropdown options use data-testid=`pos-branch-<id>` which prefix-collides with `pos-branch-selector` (same pitfall as pos-product-grid); consider `pos-branch-option-<id>`.
ProductGrid loading skeleton introduces ~1s delay on every query/category change; automated tests must wait ~1.5s - acceptable but worth documenting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 bug fixes verified, 14/14 regression checks passed)

seed_data_creation: None persisted; localStorage 'diedo-pos' cleared before each POS run. Created transient TEST_gasto expense (toast-only mock).
test_credentials: N/A - app has no auth (logout is a toast-only mock)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use [data-testid='pos-product-grid'] [data-testid^='pos-product-'] to avoid matching the grid itself; branch options are pos-branch-<id> (not pos-branch-option-). Product grid re-renders behind a ~1s skeleton after search/category changes - wait >=1.5s before counting. On mobile both CartSidebar and CartDrawer mount duplicate testids: use .filter(visible=True).first. Cart scroll area only overflows when >=4-5 items or viewport height <=800px; sidebar nav only overflows below ~800px height.
rca_of_the_issue: Earlier-looking mismatches in category/search counts during the 3rd run were a test-timing artifact of the ProductGrid loading skeleton, not an app defect; re-running with 1.8s waits produced correct counts (18 / 5 / 1).
